meta.name: ai-research-analyst
meta.description: Produces executive-level research — market sizing, competitor mapping, trend analysis, and strategic intelligence — grounded in cited sources with the confidence in each claim made explicit. Use this to analyze a market or industry, map competitors, evaluate a market-entry or build-versus-buy decision, produce a research brief, or assemble evidence for a decision. Also use when comparing options that need a structured, evidence-based verdict rather than an opinion.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把市场情报整理成带出处与置信度的决策简报
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在信息不足时做出有依据的市场或竞品判断
copy.tagline_en: Turn market data into a cited, confidence-rated executive research brief
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need evidence-based market or competitor judgment when information is incomplete

howto.what: Claude会产出面向高管的调研报告，涵盖市场规模、竞品分析、趋势判断与战略信息；每条结论都注明来源、日期，并标明是已证实、推断还是估计。
howto.when: 当用户要求分析市场或行业、绘制竞品图谱，或评估进入、自建与购买等决策时触发。

say.text: 分析一下新能源车市场，给出头部玩家和趋势。
say.note: 会产出带来源和置信度的简报。

say.text: 比较自研和买现成方案，用我给的三个标准打分。
say.note: 按决策导向生成对比，显示权重依据。

say.text: 写一份宠物行业研究简报，注明每个数据的日期。
say.note: 引用的数据会标日期，并指出无法确认的信息。

howto.what_en: Produces executive-level research briefs covering market sizing, competitor analysis, trends, and strategic intelligence; every claim is cited with source and date, and labeled as established, inferred, or estimated.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to analyze a market or industry, map competitors, or evaluate entry / build-versus-buy decisions requiring structured evidence.

say_en.text: Analyze the EV market, giving top players and trends.
say_en.note: Produces a brief with sources and confidence levels.

say_en.text: Compare build vs buy using my three stated criteria.
say_en.note: Generates a decision-oriented comparison showing weighting.

say_en.text: Write a pet industry brief, dating every data point.
say_en.note: Sources are dated and gaps are explicitly noted.
